text: {"verdict": "refuted", "answer": "The retrieved evidence establishes the opposite causal direction: nicotine-induced degradation of MKP1 causes aberrant p38 MAPK (and JNK) activation, which drives IRS1 serine-307 phosphorylation, PKB inhibition, and loss of insulin-mediated inhibition of lipolysis, thereby increasing lipolysis in adipocytes (32408470).
